sections.title: Social Construction and Social Work Practice: Transforming Dialogues
sections.description: This course will focus on the application of a social constructionist orientation to social work practice with an emphasis on its transforming potential. A primary objective of this course is to encourage you to reflect on and critically analyze traditional and contemporary issues germane to social work by using social constructionist ideas to explore how assumptions and dominant understandings of these issues are connected to policies and practices and the possibilities for transformative change.
